answer:
I **couldn’t verify a current product called “Wiggle & Snug Bum Balm 4 oz”** in the sources I checked, and I also didn’t find an official discontinuation notice for that exact name.

What I did find:

- If you mean **Dabble & Dollop Hug & Heal™ Bum Balm**, it appears to be an active/current product, but it’s **3.4 fl oz / 100 ml**, not 4 oz. The Dabble & Dollop product page currently shows it as **sold out**, while Target’s listing shows it **in stock** at **$15.99**. ([dabbleanddollop.com](https://dabbleanddollop.com/products/hug-heal-bum-balm))
- Dabble & Dollop also lists Hug & Heal™ Bum Balm as part of its current Baby Collection, so it does **not** look discontinued—just possibly out of stock on the brand’s own site. ([dabbleanddollop.com](https://dabbleanddollop.com/products/cuddle-cloud-all-over-lotion))
- If you specifically need a **4 oz Baby Bum Balm**, Wild Carrot Herbals currently lists **Baby Bum Balm – 4 oz Size** as available, with inventory shown as available on its product data. ([wildcarrotherbals.com](https://www.wildcarrotherbals.com/products/baby-bum-balm-new-4-oz-size))

**Bottom line:** I don’t see evidence that the likely matching product has been discontinued. But the exact “Wiggle & Snug Bum Balm 4 oz” name may be a misremembered/renamed product or a retailer-specific listing. If you have a photo, UPC, or store where you bought it, I can narrow it down further.
